passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sing this song while going up to Jerusalem.
They call this type of song a "song of ascents."

passages.text: Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
I am in deep trouble.
I call to You, LORD.
I cry out to You from the depths.

passages.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
passages.sermon:
The psalmist speaks to the Lord.
The psalmist asks the Lord to hear his voice.
The psalmist asks the Lord to listen carefully.
The psalmist asks the Lord to pay attention to his plea for mercy.
passages.original: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֪ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

passages.text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy and judges sin.
The LORD sees every iniquity.
If You, LORD, kept a record of every sin,
No one could stand before You.
No person could endure Your judgment.
passages.original: אִם־ עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמָר־ יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
passages.sermon:
God, You have forgiveness.
You forgive people.
Because You forgive, people respect You.
People honor You because You forgive.

passages.text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
passages.sermon: I wait for the LORD.\r\nMy soul waits for the LORD.\r\nI put my hope in His word.
passages.original: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָר֥וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃

passages.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents by David.
My soul waits for the Lord.
I wait for the Lord with deep longing.
I wait more eagerly than watchmen wait for the morning.
Watchmen look for the first light of dawn.
I wait for the Lord even more than they wait for morning.
passages.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַֽאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
passages.sermon: Israel, put your hope in the LORD.\r\nThe LORD shows loving devotion.\r\nThe LORD gives abundant redemption.
passages.original: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ יְה֫וָה כִּֽי־ עִם־ יְהוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣וֹ פְדֽוּת׃

passages.text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
passages.sermon:
God will act.
God will redeem Israel.
God will save Israel from all iniquity.
God will remove every sin from Israel.
passages.original: וְ֭הוּא יִפְדֶּ֣ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל עֲוֺנֹתָֽיו׃
